classic.texte: Two teams of five, three lanes, one Nexus to destroy. The founding mode, without ranking issues: ideal for discovering a hero or warming up.

ranked.texte: The competitive line. Each victory earns stars and raises Warning to Mythical Glory, with bans and selection in draft from Epic.

brawl.texte: Single card has a lane, hero draws lots. Short and nervous games, without jungle or long return to base phase.

vs-ai.texte: Opponents controlled by AI, with adjustable difficulty. To test a build or tame a new hero without the pressure of ranking.

custom.texte: Create a tailor-made game: team composition, spectators, map and free parameters. The mode of tournaments and matches between friends.

arcade-mode.texte: A rotation of special and festive modes – Magic Hunt, Survival and other variants – offered for a limited time.
